verdict.rationale: Reflect's advanced search docs describe semantic search for finding information without exact words. They also list filters by #tags, date created/updated, daily notes, backlink relationships and pinned notes, and let you chat with the filtered note set. That covers tag filtering and search, but only part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit full-text/keyword search documentation, filters on properties and paths, any evidence of offline search, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search speed.
